title: VTC Booking — Bookings — Cancel — payload
description: The booker cancels their booking while the tier's notice allows, or the host cancels any booking on their page at any time. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Shown on the cancelled event. Plain text.

Response.title: VTC Booking — Bookings — Cancel — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/booking/bookings/cancel/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/booking/bookings/cancel/0.1#response.

changed.description: False when the booking was already cancelled.
